review_scope: 28 component-body masks per view across three full ESP32 photos (84 image instances). Includes 15 corrected selected-package masks and 69 newly reviewed smaller-package masks; 90 pre-existing printed contact aliases remain point metadata.
identity_limits: U2 CP2102 family is readable; installed full ordering suffix remains unresolved.
U1 and the two small three-terminal parts have unreadable complete identities.
Chip passive markings are literal text; no resistance, capacitance, refdes, or BOM row is inferred.
Header aliases are reviewed point metadata, not pin-body masks or chip-pin numbers.
remaining_review: Mask individual exposed contacts with parent-part orientation evidence.
Review residual or occluded body boundaries before declaring exhaustive coverage.
Verify full RF module outline versus shield-only scope consistently across views.
Resolve exact identities or explicitly define observable-family classes before training.
Construct an independent evaluation split from separately reviewed captures/specimens.
Resolve the four repeated unknown-package identities only if new visual or source evidence supports it; keep them unknown otherwise.
